channel.title: Release Radar — @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm)
channel.description: Releases of @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm) in the last 7 days; flagged ones carry a verbatim quote. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.319 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the project Quote: - Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt Quote: - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` so that settings files can no longer set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.318 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process Quote: - Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed Quote: - Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.318

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.317 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval Quote: - Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.317
